set.body: Implement Analysis.dc.html history on existing document model: draft rev5, rev4/run7/current, rev4/run6/cancelled, rev3/run5/r2/stale; exact revision/run selection; saved recipe read-only; immutable navigation; stable focus/selected toggle; initial creation only on admitted data with no saved analysis. Existing edits create meaningful drafts; preserve NoChanges refusal. Pure JVM/JS regressions and AnalysesNavigatorFxSuite, a11y and board evidence. Parent S7.7 remains open for independent families.
